results.title: US consortium wins huge Kenya mining deal, beating Chinese rivals - BBC
results.snippet: A US-led consortium, Frontier Minerals, has won the tender to develop Kenya's Mrima Hill mining project, beating seven bidders, including companies from China and Australia.
